title: Hezekiah's Reform: Idols Destroyed
description: When all this was finished, all the Israelites who were present went out to the towns of Judah. They smashed the stone pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and tore down the sacrificial mounds and altars throughout Judah and Benjamin, as well as in Ephraim and Manasseh, until everything was destroyed. Then all the people of Israel returned, each to their own property in their towns.
